Cancellation & Refund Policy

Transparent Cancellation Terms & Verified Refund Processing Guidelines

Entity / Trade Name: Charak Health Solutions

💳 What Website Payments Cover

“Payments on this website are collected for personal consultation bookings and live educational webinar registrations. Physical medicines, supplements and other products are not sold or shipped through these checkout flows.”

At Charak Health Solutions, we value patient trust and transparency. We understand that medical schedules, travel difficulties, and health emergencies can alter plans. Below are our clear, service-specific cancellation, rescheduling, and refund rules.

1. In-Clinic Personal Consultation Bookings (₹1,000)

Consultation bookings secure a dedicated 30-minute clinical evaluation with Dr. Surabhi Vaidya at our Thane West clinic:

  • Advance Cancellation & Rescheduling Window: Patients may reschedule or cancel their appointment up to 12 hours prior to their scheduled time slot at zero penalty or cost.
  • Complimentary Rescheduling: If you experience unexpected travel delays or acute joint pain flare-ups on the appointment day, our clinic desk will gladly reschedule your visit to any mutually available date and time slot within 30 days at no extra fee.
  • Verified Refund Eligibility: If you paid the ₹1,000 consultation fee online and submit a cancellation request at least 12 hours prior to your scheduled slot, you are eligible for a 100% full refund.
  • Non-Attendance / No-Show Rule: When an appointment is booked and paid online, the clinical time is reserved exclusively for the patient. If a patient does not attend the consultation and fails to provide notice prior to the scheduled time, the booking fee is non-refundable; however, the patient may contact our clinic desk within 30 days to request a one-time courtesy reschedule.
  • Pay-at-Clinic Bookings: Patients who select the "Pay at Clinic Desk" option during scheduling pay upon arrival; no online charges are debited in advance.

2. Live Educational Masterclass / Webinar Registrations (₹201)

Webinar bookings secure interactive digital access to our live 90-minute educational broadcast on Webinar.gg:

  • Non-Cancellable & Non-Refundable: Due to immediate digital delivery of joining credentials, reserved platform seat allocation, and digital broadcast costs, registrations for the Live Educational Masterclass (₹201) are strictly non-cancellable and non-refundable once purchased.
  • Non-Transferable: Webinar registrations are strictly non-transferable to other dates, future webinar batches, or other individuals. Please ensure your availability before completing your registration.
  • Exceptions: A full refund will be processed only in the rare event of an organizer cancellation where the session cannot be rescheduled, or in the case of verified duplicate payments.

3. Organiser Cancellations, Postponements & Technical Exceptions

  • Clinic or Doctor Rescheduling: In the rare event that Dr. Surabhi Vaidya must reschedule or cancel a consultation or live webinar due to unforeseen clinical emergencies or illness, affected patients/attendees will be notified immediately via WhatsApp, phone, and email. Patients will be offered priority rescheduling at their earliest convenience or an immediate 100% full refund.
  • Webinar Postponement: If a scheduled webinar session is postponed by the organizer, attendees will receive advance notification with the revised date and time. Any attendee unable to make the rescheduled time will receive an immediate 100% refund upon request.
  • Duplicate Payments: If technical lag or accidental multiple clicks result in duplicate debits for the same consultation or webinar booking, our accounts team will verify the duplicate transaction and initiate an immediate full refund of the excess payment.
  • Failed, Interrupted, or Unconfirmed Bookings: If funds are debited from your bank or UPI account but the website session timed out before generating an on-screen confirmation, the payment gateway typically reverses the amount automatically within 3 to 5 banking days. If not reversed, simply contact our clinic desk with your bank UTR / payment reference; we will immediately either confirm your booking pass manually or initiate a full refund.

4. Refund Processing Timeline, Method & Eligibility

In accordance with banking regulations and authorized payment gateway standards:

  • Verification & Initiation: Once a refund request is received and verified against our booking records, our accounts desk initiates the refund within 24 to 48 business hours.
  • Refund Method: Approved refunds are credited exclusively back to the original source of payment (the original UPI ID/VPA, bank account, debit card, or credit card used during checkout). We do not issue cash refunds for online transactions.
  • Bank Credit Timeline: Following initiation, the funds typically reflect in the customer's account within 5 to 7 working days, depending on your bank or card issuer's clearing cycle.

5. How to Request a Cancellation or Refund

To cancel a booking, reschedule your slot, or request a refund, please contact our clinic support desk via email or WhatsApp:
